status: dirty tracking not justified by current measurement; no guest-private dirty-state contract exists
scope: After reverse-position index; Actually Additions crusher, 1/100/1000, idle and one iron-ore/no-energy case, 40 ticks per state, both single-player modes.
limits: CPU 0-5, nice 10, Rayon 6, temporary game/launcher/XDG homes; one session per mode.

decision.idle_serialization_share: p50 serialize is 0.474 ms of 6.440 ms total in server-thread (7.4%) and 0.529 ms of 7.070 ms in-frame (7.5%). In input-present/no-energy state it is 0.531 ms of 10.021 ms server-thread (5.3%) and 0.544 ms of 9.456 ms in-frame (5.8%).
decision.dominant_stages: Idle callbacks and view copies exceed serialization in both modes; input-present/no-energy callback and view-copy stages are larger still.
decision.guest_contract: The guest owns private serialized block-entity state; host currently calls save_block_entity every tick and detects change only after serialization. No dirty notification or versioned-state contract is exposed.
decision.action: Do not implement dirty tracking. The measured serialization share is small and no clear guest-private change signal contract exists. Reconsider only if a new profile/hypothesis shows material serialization cost and a dirty-state API can be specified without losing saves.
